# Érudit

> > Érudit is a comprehensive open-access digital library providing access to scholarly journals, books, and theses in humanities and social sciences, primarily from French-speaking academia.

Érudit serves as a major repository for academic publishing in French-language scholarship, offering advanced search capabilities and curated collections across multiple disciplines. The platform implements Anubis proof-of-work security measures to prevent automated scraping while maintaining open access to scholarly content.

## Key Topics

- Open-access publishing
- Academic journals
- Scholarly publishing
- French-language content

## Core Collections

- [Érudit Homepage](https://www.erudit.org): Main entry point providing access to journals, books, and theses in humanities and social sciences
- [French Homepage](https://www.erudit.org/fr): French-language homepage with bot protection using Anubis proof-of-work challenge
- [English Homepage](https://www.erudit.org/en): English-language homepage with Anubis proof-of-work bot protection challenge
- [Journal Directory](https://www.erudit.org/fr/revues): Comprehensive directory of academic journals protected by Anubis bot-protection challenge
- [Theses Collection](https://www.erudit.org/fr/theses): Collection of academic theses with Anubis proof-of-work security verification
- [Books Collection](https://www.erudit.org/fr/livres): Scholarly books collection protected by Anubis Hashcash challenge system

## Search & Discovery

- [Advanced Search](https://www.erudit.org/fr/recherche/avancee): Advanced search interface with boolean operators and filters for querying the Érudit academic database

## Featured Journals

- [Revue québécoise de droit international](https://www.erudit.org/fr/revues/rqdi): Quebec Journal of International Law journal homepage with bot protection
- [XYZ. La revue de la nouvelle](https://www.erudit.org/fr/revues/xyz): XYZ literary journal homepage with Anubis Hashcash security verification
- [Entre vous](https://www.erudit.org/fr/revues/entrevous): Entre vous journal homepage with Anubis proof-of-work security system

## Document Repository

- [Érudit Dépôt de documents](https://depot.erudit.org): Érudit document repository on DSpace platform for open-access scholarly content

## User Accounts

- [User Login & Account Access](https://www.erudit.org/fr/compte/bienvenue): Login portal for librarians and journal managers to access account features

## Optional

- [Notices Page](https://www.erudit.org/fr/notices): Notices page with Anubis security challenge for bot detection
